content: Root cause: The bug was introduced due to changes made in commit 4cf482c0ce that affected the handling of the CRC configuration in the NRF communication. Specifically, the `ENABLE_CRC` configuration was improperly set based on the condition that checks `nrf_ctx.crc_len`, leading to CRC errors during data transmission. The patch corrected this by ensuring that CRC was enabled by default and optimized the handling of dynamic payload setup, which was affected by state management issues.
